info.title: FarisCommerce API
info.description: CRUD API for the FarisCommerce database plus external product and OLX shop-listing search.

get.summary: Search an external product catalog or an OLX seller's active listings
get.description: Default source is DummyJSON's public product search. Use source=olx with a configured OLX token and seller username to search that seller's active listings on the requested page. OLX's documented endpoint does not provide global keyword search, so filtering is local to the fetched page.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request or business rule violation

Forbidden.description: Token is valid but does not permit this operation
